name: cover-flow
title: Cover Flow
author: ncdai <dai@chanhdai.com>
description: Row of covers that turn in 3D as you scroll, inspired by Cover Flow on iOS 6.

@utility cover-flow-transform.transform: translateX(calc(var(--cover-flow-turn) * var(--cover-flow-first) + (var(--cover-flow-offset) - var(--cover-flow-turn)) * var(--cover-flow-step) - var(--cover-flow-offset) * var(--cover-flow-size))) perspective(calc(var(--cover-flow-size) * 3)) translateZ(calc(abs(var(--cover-flow-turn)) * var(--cover-flow-depth))) rotateY(calc(var(--cover-flow-turn) * var(--cover-flow-angle) * -1))

@supports (animation-timeline: view()).animation-range: cover calc(50% - var(--cover-flow-size) * 50) cover calc(50% + var(--cover-flow-size) * 50)

0%.transform: translateX(calc(var(--cover-flow-first) + var(--cover-flow-step) * 49 - var(--cover-flow-size) * 50)) perspective(calc(var(--cover-flow-size) * 3)) translateZ(var(--cover-flow-depth)) rotateY(calc(var(--cover-flow-angle) * -1))

100%.transform: translateX(calc(var(--cover-flow-size) * 50 - var(--cover-flow-first) - var(--cover-flow-step) * 49)) perspective(calc(var(--cover-flow-size) * 3)) translateZ(var(--cover-flow-depth)) rotateY(var(--cover-flow-angle))
